_comment: Exclude test fixtures from self-scan. These directories contain intentionally unguarded code used to test the scanner itself — they are NOT production code and should not produce findings. Without this exclusion, `actenon-scan scan .` on this repo reports 70+ findings from benchmark precision/recall fixtures, corpus vulnerable/safe pairs, and test fixtures. A maintainer who receives a finding from us will run our tool on our repo; they see the number before they read a single path.
